description: This file defines the LogLevel enum used for specifying different logging levels within the Eclipse Ditto project's devops module. It includes methods to get an enum value from a string identifier and to retrieve the string identifier of a LogLevel.

classes.name: LogLevel
classes.description: An enumeration representing various logging levels such as OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE, and ALL, each associated with a string identifier. Includes methods to obtain a LogLevel from a string identifier and to get the identifier of a LogLevel.

methods.name: forIdentifier
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an Optional containing the LogLevel corresponding to the provided string identifier, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the string identifier associated with this LogLevel enum value.
